precise_claim_summary: Original NN/g UX heuristic explains how prompt feedback and visible progress prevent user uncertainty and mistaken repeated taps.
counter_and_scope_limits: Practitioner heuristic, no app-specific randomized experiment or measured conversion/click rates.

publisher: Nielsen Norman Group/Tim Neusesser & Evan Sunwall
precise_claim_summary: Original NN/g authors give error visibility, proximity, helpful repair instructions and preserving user's work.
counter_and_scope_limits: Same organization as N896_S016; do not count two NN/g pages as independent confirmation. No specific app measured.

precise_claim_summary: WCAG criterion 1.4.3: normal text minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1, large text 3:1, with exceptions.
counter_and_scope_limits: The Understanding document is informative explanation of criterion. No assessment of the planned dark-green UI, logo or native app.

precise_claim_summary: Criterion 3.3.1: when input error is automatically identified, affected field and error text should be communicated.
counter_and_scope_limits: Same W3C origin as N896_S018. This is rule text, not user field evidence; doesn't prove local app compliance.

precise_claim_summary: Official iPhone feature support table distinguishes animation, audio, printing and editing capabilities from desktop experience.
counter_and_scope_limits: Vendor claim; versions, subscription and device differences remain; no file-level fidelity test. Vendor output does not imply user satisfaction.

precise_claim_summary: Official cross-platform matrix shows e.g. PowerPoint master editing supported on PC/Mac but not PowerPoint Web. Mobile capabilities differ from desktop.
counter_and_scope_limits: Same origin group as N896_S020 and other Microsoft docs. Not evidence of all competitors' compatibility.

publisher: Dillon et al., NBER Working Paper 33795
precise_claim_summary: 66 firms and 7137 workers randomized access to integrated AI tool; among 80% treated workers using it, weekly email time declined two hours in latter half, but not clear general coordination/task shifts.
counter_and_scope_limits: Email work result is NOT measured slide-authoring speed. Some authors were Microsoft employees, paper noted funding/affiliate transparency. Original HTML search text, direct open cache miss.

precise_claim_summary: Authors introduce multimodal long-document summarization benchmark noting key-information omission and cross-modal hallucination; evaluate keyword coverage, alignment, ROUGE and claim precision/recall.
counter_and_scope_limits: Preprint abstract only; not an independent reproduction, not proof of any commercial app's error rate; PDF/full methods not inspected.
